name: astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.shared_identity_contract_remediated_v1
view_definition:
SELECT instrument_key,
    session_date,
    alpaca_asset_id,
    identity_anchor,
    identity_eligible,
    identity_recorded_at,
    currency_code,
    native_source_symbol,
    internal_instrument_id,
    internal_uuid_matches,
    sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(instrument_key, session_date, alpaca_asset_id, identity_anchor, identity_eligible, identity_recorded_at, currency_code, native_source_symbol, internal_instrument_id, internal_uuid_matches)::text, 'UTF8'::name)) AS identity_contract_sha256
   FROM ( SELECT d.instrument_key,
            d.session_date,
            u.alpaca_asset_id,
            d.identity_anchor,
            d.identity_anchor IS NOT NULL AND (d.quality_flags & 12) = 0 AS identity_eligible,
            GREATEST(d.built_at, o.identity_reconciled_at, r.ingested_at, st.latest_loaded_at) AS identity_recorded_at,
            upper(COALESCE(NULLIF(o.currency_name, ''::text), NULLIF(r.raw_payload ->> 'currency_name'::text, ''::text),
                CASE
                    WHEN st.n = 1 THEN NULLIF(st.currency_name, ''::text)
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END)) AS currency_code,
            COALESCE(o.native_symbol,
                CASE
                    WHEN r.identity_certification_state = 'CERTIFIED_EXACT_DATE_COMPOSITE_AND_SHARE_FIGI_NATIVE_SOURCE_RECONCILED_V8'::text THEN r.historical_source_symbol
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END) AS native_source_symbol,
                CASE
                    WHEN pm.n = 1 THEN pm.internal_id
                    ELSE NULL::uuid
                END AS internal_instrument_id,
            COALESCE(pm.n, 0) AS internal_uuid_matches
           FROM market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.security_daily_features_remediated_v1 d
             JOIN reference.alpaca_fixed_window_instruments_v1 u USING (instrument_key)
             LEFT JOIN reference.equity_identity_day_overrides_remediation_v1 o USING (instrument_key, session_date)
             LEFT JOIN market_factors_20250901_20260731_v1.precursor_identity_day_reconciliation_v8 r USING (instrument_key, session_date)
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS n,
                    min(s.currency_name) AS currency_name,
                    max(s.loaded_at) AS latest_loaded_at
                   FROM reference.equity_security_state_v1 s
                  WHERE s.instrument_key = d.instrument_key AND d.session_date >= s.valid_from AND d.session_date < s.valid_to) st ON true
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.metadata ->> 'id'::text AS native_asset_uuid,
                    count(*)::integer AS n,
                    min(i.id::text)::uuid AS internal_id
                   FROM instruments i
                  WHERE i.provider = 'alpaca'::text AND NULLIF(i.metadata ->> 'id'::text, ''::text) IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY (i.metadata ->> 'id'::text)) pm ON pm.native_asset_uuid = u.alpaca_asset_id::text) x;
